periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation with the primary axis angled approximately 45 degrees towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval/teardrop shape with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio along the dominant axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering with the lowest point extending toward the infraorbital region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the cranial vault, approximately equal to the width of the frontal bone area.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-tan discoloration/staining of the ventral and abdominal fur relative to the white cranial fur.
